title: Replace bike chain
description: The chain on my commuter bike is worn out. Replace it with a new chain and check the tension and lubrication.

criteria.label: Chain is new/clean and fully seated on the sprockets
criteria.howToVerify: Look at the chain: it should be clean and new-looking, with every link seated on the front and rear sprocket teeth. Rust or a loose chain fails.

criteria.label: Chain tension looks correct (no excessive sag)
criteria.howToVerify: The lower run of the chain should be tight with only a small amount of play. A hanging or drooping chain fails.

criteria.label: Drivetrain is lubricated without excess oil
criteria.howToVerify: The chain should look lightly oiled, not dripping or dry. Visible thick globs of oil fail.

criteria.label: Work area and bike left tidy
criteria.howToVerify: No tools, packaging or dirty rags left around the bike.

criteria.label: Liveness code {CODE} visible in at least one after photo (written on paper or shown on a phone screen)
criteria.howToVerify: Look for a handwritten or phone-displayed 4 digit code in the after photos and read it.
